title: Gully's plan
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
source: lore/drift_wood/_THE_COMPLETE_RUN.md (1999–2000 · deepening xix · the daily filled)
logline: Gully has a plan for the Fourth: the pots off the wall to sit on, the thermos, the fireworks off the dock's end, the uncle's chair moved to the dock. Wood's plan: none. Chloe's plan: unstated. The uncle's: red ones.

panels.composition: The dock. GULLY pacing it off with his boots, planning out loud. WOOD on a pot. BARNABY. The UNCLE in the chair by the shack.

image.prompt: a stocky teenager pacing a dock off with his boots and gesturing while a young man sits on a crab pot and an old man watches from a lawn chair, black and white, no words

balloons.text: Pots to sit on. Thermos. Chair to the end of the dock. Rockets off the last plank.

image.prompt: a stocky teenager in a backwards cap explaining a plan with his hands, black and white, no words
an old man in a lawn chair, flat, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The dock, empty, paced off. The plan on it, invisible. Wood drawing the empty dock with the plan in it. Five days.

image.prompt: an empty wooden dock over gray water in evening light, planned but bare, black and white, no words

art.line: brush-pen, committed; black and white; xerox

notes: 'You draw it.' Five days. The plan on the empty dock.
